name: cancer-buddy
description: 抗癌搭子 — CancerDAO's patient-facing AI cancer navigator. Meta-skill plus 8 sub-skills covering the full cancer journey: medical record organization, diagnostic and treatment pathway exploration, lightweight molecular tumor board, patient-view clinical trial matching, expanded access navigation, multi-line treatment management, N=1 data vault, and patient education. Pairs with the clinician-facing vmtb-skill plugin for full molecular tumor board reports.
